record.question: Ghazi Malik, the founder of Tughlaq Dynasty was also known as:
record.explanation: Answer C: Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq. Ghazi Malik took the regnal title Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq when he founded the dynasty. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/biography/Ghiyas-al-Din-Tughluq. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then..
